titulo: Intuit (Jul 2024): $3.02 billion paid to shareholders, about 1,800 jobs will be leaving. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Jul 2024. Not today's news.
Intuit, Jul 10, 2024 (Goodarzi, email to employees): "Today is an incredibly difficult day"
On July 10, 2024, Intuit's CEO emailed employees about the cuts. The email says about 1,800 employees, 10% of the workforce, will be leaving. Buyback and dividend totals come from the 10-K.

Fiscal 2024: $3.02 billion paid to shareholders, fiscal 2024, company-wide. $1,988 million of stock repurchased plus $1,034 million of dividends in fiscal 2024, company-wide (cash flow statement, in millions).
The math: $3.02 billion in buybacks and dividends (2024) ÷ about 1,800 job cuts = about $1.678 million in buybacks and dividends per job cut.
The facts: $3.02 billion paid to shareholders, fiscal 2024, company-wide (Intuit 10-K, fiscal 2024 (SEC), Sep 4, 2024). about 1,800 jobs will be leaving (Intuit 8-K, CEO email (SEC), Jul 10, 2024). The $3.0 billion is Intuit's fiscal 2024 buybacks ($1,988 million) plus dividends ($1,034 million), company-wide, for the year that ended July 31, 2024. The same email also says Intuit will hire about 1,800 new people.

Incredibly difficult day. Here is the shareholder column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: Intuit 8-K, CEO email (SEC), Jul 10, 2024; Intuit 10-K, fiscal 2024 (SEC), Sep 4, 2024.

Swipe: the sentence, the number, the math, our take.

Tap the link in bio.
